features.name: Software Feature Reverse Engineering and Visualization
features.description: This feature analyzes a software project's source code to automatically identify and model its high-level business features, subsequently generating feature-level UML diagrams for visualization and architectural understanding across different project versions.

features.name: Reverse-Engineer Software Features
features.description: This feature analyzes source code from various languages, extracts symbols and relationships, then uses clustering to identify and label cohesive software features, generating diagrams (class and sequence) to visualize them.

features.name: AI-Powered Software Feature Identification
features.description: This feature analyzes a Git repository's codebase and commit history to automatically identify and cluster classes belonging to specific software features, leveraging a Large Language Model (LLM) for enhanced understanding and evaluation against ground truth data.
